an8.85:1.1: samaṇoti bhikkhave tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa
an8.85:1.2: brāhmaṇoti bhikkhave tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa
an8.85:1.3: vedagūti bhikkhave tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa
an8.85:1.4: bhisakkoti bhikkhave tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa
an8.85:1.5: nimmaloti bhikkhave tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa
an8.85:1.6: vimaloti bhikkhave tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa
an8.85:1.7: ñāṇīti bhikkhave tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa
an8.85:1.8: vimuttoti bhikkhave tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassāti.
